query:
SELECT
                    ep.id as "id!: Uuid",
                    ep.session_id as "session_id!: Uuid",
                    ep.run_reason as "run_reason!: ExecutionProcessRunReason",
                    COALESCE(
                        data->'executor_action',
                        '{}'::jsonb
                    ) as "executor_action!: sqlx::types::Json<ExecutorActionField>",
                    ep.status as "status!: ExecutionProcessStatus",
                    (data->>'exit_code')::int as exit_code,
                    COALESCE((data->>'dropped')::bool, false) as "dropped!: bool",
                    COALESCE(
                        (data->>'started_at')::timestamptz,
                        ep.created_at
                    ) as "started_at!: DateTime<Utc>",
                    (data->>'completed_at')::timestamptz as "completed_at: DateTime<Utc>",
                    ep.created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>",
                    ep.updated_at as "updated_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM execution_processes ep WHERE ep.status = 'running' ORDER BY ep.created_at ASC
